scope: Prove no added, removed, reordered or renamed programs; verify original IDs and Init values, changed existing controls, unique non-volume vectors, and exact final local versus delivered binary32 parameter identity. This is structural/provenance evidence, not perceptual equivalence.

digest_contract.implementation_agreement: C++ shifts the copied float bit pattern by eight bits; both Python checkers pack <f.

comparator_boundaries: CLI pins the exact canonical baseline bytes and both revision labels.
Structural comparator requires a changed prior non-master-volume control for each musical program; appended size alone, existing active body, or master-only change cannot qualify.
Structural float equality treats signed zero as the same numeric control value; the delivered/Init verification will additionally compare packed bytes, as the audio checker already does for Init.
The parameter comparator binds input bytes, not an executable, native wrapper, producing job or release artifact.

Only body controls and appended sizes receive explicit range validation in this comparator. Full declared-range admission remains the unchanged library audit plus equality to its qualified final vectors.

requirements: Artifact name contains the exact published source SHA; API source/run/ID/size/digest and expiry valid.

acceptance_sequence.check: Compare archived inventory against canonical baseline
requirements: Run scripts/compare-preset-refinement.py using the pinned baseline and actual archived inventory.
Require ordered names/categories/tags/host indices unchanged for all523 programs.
Require original198 IDs as an exact prefix, followed only by body1_size and body2_size.
Require all521 musical programs to differ in a previously published non-master-volume control; size-only or gain-only changes do not count.
Require no duplicate non-volume engine-value vectors.
For both Init programs compare all198 prior packed <f values exactly and both appended sizes to packed1.0, in addition to structural comparator admission.
Descriptions may change from baseline as authored explanatory text; this does not permit name/category/tag/address changes.

acceptance_sequence.check: Bind local final values to delivered values
requirements: Require identical schema, revision and ordered IDs.
Require every ordered program field, including description and tags, to match the final local inventory.
Compare all104600 parameter values as packed little-endian binary32 bytes, including signed-zero bits; require zero mismatches.
Record both raw inventory SHA256 values. A raw-byte mismatch must be explained and investigated; never use formatting normalization to hide a field or value change.
Recompute all523 per-program digests independently. Bind any actual archived CSV row to its exact program digest and report the74-program rendered subset separately from full inventory coverage.
Record artifact/member/local/baseline hashes, source and run/attempt, tool hashes, comparison counts and exact failures, if any.
Record actual min/max changed-control counts and model/family coverage from the final values, never copy earlier development totals.
Keep no-new-presets, compatibility, rendered sound safety and perceptual claims separate; full native wrapper and MIDI routing tests belong to platform qualification.

structural_comparison_argv_template: Actual verified audition inventory for <source-SHA>, run <run-ID>, attempt <attempt>
limitations: No final candidate inventory, newly published source, native executable or actual release artifact has been accepted by worker50 yet.
